
# This file has code for the statistical analysis done on the sentiment analysis

```{r}
library("dplyr")
```


```{r}
data = read.csv("")
```


```{r}
data_filtered = data |> select(country, period, outlet, sentence, doc_id, headline, Name, p_pos, p_neg, year, topic)
```

## Article Count by Outlet and Period
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
count_by_period = data_filtered |> 
  group_by(outlet, period) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = n, fill = outlet)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Article Count by Outlet and Period",
       y = "Total count of articles in subset",
       x = "Period")  + geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

art <- data_filtered |>
  mutate(is_neg = as.integer(p_neg > 0.5)) |>
  group_by(doc_id, outlet, country, period, Name, year) |>
  summarise(
    n_sent   = n(),
    n_neg    = sum(is_neg),
    prop_neg = n_neg / n_sent,
    mean_pneg = mean(p_neg),        
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_sent >= 3) |>
  mutate(
    period = relevel(factor(period), ref = "Pre"),
    outlet = factor(outlet)
  ) |> mutate(prop_pos = 1 - prop_neg)
```

```{r}
         outlet %in% c("FT", "WSJ")) |>

m <- glm(prop_neg ~ period * outlet,
```

```{r}
library(purrr); library(broom)

pairs <- list(c("Guardian","NYT"), c("FT","WSJ"), c("Sun","NYPost"))

res <- map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
  map_dfr(unique(art$Name), function(tp) {
    d <- art |>
      filter(Name == tp, outlet %in% p) |>
      mutate(outlet = relevel(factor(outlet), ref = p[1]))

    if (n_distinct(d$outlet) < 2 || n_distinct(d$period) < 2) return(NULL)

    glm(prop_neg ~ period * outlet,
        family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
        weights = n_sent, data = d) |>
      tidy() |>
      filter(grepl(":", term)) |>
      mutate(topic = tp, pair = paste(p, collapse = "-"))
  })
}) |>
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
```

## DID REGRESSION FOR APPENDIX

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(broom); library(sandwich); library(lmtest); library(emmeans)

art <- data_filtered |> filter(outlet != "Sun") |> filter(outlet != "NP") |>
  group_by(doc_id, outlet, country, period, year) |>
  summarise(mean_pos = mean(p_pos),
            n_sent   = n(),
            .groups  = "drop") |>
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
         outlet = factor(outlet),
         year   = as.integer(year))


fit_pair <- function(df, o1, o2) {
  d <- df |>
    filter(outlet %in% c(o1, o2)) |>
    mutate(outlet = relevel(droplevels(outlet), ref = o1))
  glm(mean_pos ~ period * outlet, data = d,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
}

m_ft_wsj  <- fit_pair(art, "FT", "WSJ")
m_gua_nyt <- fit_pair(art, "Guardian", "NYTimes")
m_wsj_nyt <- fit_pair(art, "WSJ", "NYTimes")
m_ft_gua  <- fit_pair(art, "FT", "Guardian")

models <- list(FT_vs_WSJ = m_ft_wsj, Guardian_vs_NYT = m_gua_nyt,
               WSJ_vs_NYT = m_wsj_nyt, FT_vs_Guardian = m_ft_gua)

results <- purrr::imap_dfr(models, \(m, nm)
  tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) |> mutate(pair = nm, .before = 1))



results_did <- results |> filter(term |> stringr::str_detect("^period.*outlet"))

p_adj_df <- tibble(
  pair = results_did$pair,
  term = results_did$term,
  p.value_adj = p.adjust(results_did$p.value, method = "BH")
)

results <- results |> 
  left_join(p_adj_df, by = c("pair", "term")) |>
  mutate(p.value_adj = coalesce(p.value_adj, p.value))


results |> 
  select(pair, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p.value_adj) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
```


```{r}

m_pool <- glm(mean_pos ~ period * outlet, data = art,
              family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
  



emm_did <- emmeans(m_pool, ~ period | outlet) |> contrast("revpairwise")
contrast(emm_did, "revpairwise", by = NULL, adjust = "BH")


m_country <- glm(mean_pos ~ period * country, data = art,
                 family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)


m_trend <- glm(mean_pos ~ year * outlet, data = filter(art, period == "Pre"),
               family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)

emm <- emmeans(m_pool, ~ outlet | period)
pairs(emm, adjust = "BH")     
emmeans(m_trend, ~ outlet | year, type = "response")

art |>
  group_by(outlet, year) |>
  summarise(n = n(), pos = weighted.mean(mean_pos, n_sent),
            se = sd(mean_pos)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(year, pos, colour = outlet)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = pos - 1.96*se, ymax = pos + 1.96*se)) +
 geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(y = "Weighted Mean of the Assigned Probability of Positive Sentiment", title = "Positive Sentiment by Outlet and Year")
```




```{r}
library(emmeans)

art <- art |> mutate(year_f = factor(year))

m_year <- glm(mean_pos ~ outlet * year_f, data = art,
              family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)

emm_df <- emmeans(m_year, ~ outlet | year_f, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(as.character(year_f)))

ggplot(emm_df, aes(year, prob, colour = outlet)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(y = "Weighted Mean of the Predicted Probability of Positive Sentiment", title = "Positive Sentiment by Outlet and Year")
```

```{r}
art <- art |> 
  mutate(year_f = relevel(factor(year), ref = "2022"))

es_pair <- function(df, o1, o2) {
  d <- df |>
    filter(outlet %in% c(o1, o2)) |>
    mutate(outlet = relevel(droplevels(factor(outlet)), ref = o1))
  glm(mean_pos ~ year_f * outlet, data = d,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
}

es_models <- list(
  FT_vs_WSJ       = es_pair(art, "FT", "WSJ"),
  Guardian_vs_NYT = es_pair(art, "Guardian", "NYTimes"),
  WSJ_vs_NYT      = es_pair(art, "WSJ", "NYTimes"),
  FT_vs_Guardian  = es_pair(art, "FT", "Guardian")
)


es_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(es_models, \(m, nm)
  broom::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(grepl("^year_f.*:outlet", term)) |>
    mutate(pair = nm,
           year = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(term, "\\d{4}"))))

es_df <- bind_rows(
  es_df,
  tibble(pair = names(es_models), year = 2022,
         estimate = 0, conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0)
)

ggplot(es_df, aes(year, estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair) +
  labs(y = "DiD estimate (log-odds, relative to 2022)",
       x = "year",
       title = "Event study: outlet sentiment gaps by year")
```

## REFERENCE YEAR ROBUSTNESS CHECK
```{r}
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(broom); library(purrr); library(stringr)


art <- data_filtered |>
  group_by(doc_id, outlet, country, period, year) |>
  summarise(mean_pos = mean(p_pos),
            n_sent   = n(),
            .groups  = "drop") |>
  mutate(year   = as.integer(year),
         year_f = relevel(factor(year), ref = "2021"),   # 2021 = last "normal" pre year
         period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre", "Post")))


es_pair <- function(df, o1, o2) {
  d <- df |>
    filter(outlet %in% c(o1, o2)) |>
    mutate(outlet = relevel(droplevels(factor(outlet)), ref = o1),
           year_f = droplevels(year_f))
  glm(mean_pos ~ year_f * outlet, data = d,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
}

pairs_list <- list(
  FT_vs_WSJ       = c("FT", "WSJ"),
  Guardian_vs_NYT = c("Guardian", "NYTimes"),
  WSJ_vs_NYT      = c("WSJ", "NYTimes"),
  FT_vs_Guardian  = c("FT", "Guardian")
)


get_es <- function(df, base) {
  d <- df |> mutate(year_f = relevel(factor(year), ref = base))
  imap_dfr(pairs_list, \(o, nm) {
    m <- es_pair(d, o[1], o[2])
    tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(str_detect(term, "^year_f.*:outlet")) |>
      mutate(pair = nm,
             year = as.integer(str_extract(term, "\\d{4}")),
             base = base)
  }) |>
    bind_rows(tibble(pair = names(pairs_list), year = as.integer(base),
                     estimate = 0, conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0, base = base))
}

es_df <- get_es(art, "2021")


p_es <- ggplot(es_df, aes(year, estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.92, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(es_df$year))) +
  labs(y = "DiD estimate (log-odds, relative to 2021)", x = "Year",
       title = "Event study: outlet sentiment gaps by year",
       subtitle = "Reference year 2021; dashed line marks ChatGPT release (Nov 2022)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_es


es_robust <- map_dfr(c("2020", "2021", "2022"), \(b) get_es(art, b))

ggplot(es_robust, aes(year, estimate, colour = base, shape = base)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.92, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(es_robust$year))) +
  labs(y = "DiD estimate (log-odds)", x = "Year", colour = "Year", shape = "Year",
       title = "Event Study Sensitivity to Reference Year") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)


did_pair <- function(o1, o2) {
  d <- art |>
    filter(outlet %in% c(o1, o2)) |>
    mutate(outlet = relevel(droplevels(factor(outlet)), ref = o1))
  glm(mean_pos ~ period * outlet, data = d,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
}
did_models <- map(pairs_list, \(o) did_pair(o[1], o[2]))

did_tab <- imap_dfr(did_models, \(m, nm)
  tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, ":")) |>
    mutate(pair = nm, dispersion = summary(m)$dispersion)) |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, "BH"))

did_tab 
```

## MAIN EVENT STUDY FOR FINAL PAPER
```{r}
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(broom); library(purrr); library(stringr)


art <- data_filtered |>
  group_by(doc_id, outlet, country, period, year) |>
  summarise(mean_pos = mean(p_pos),
            n_sent   = n(),
            .groups  = "drop") |>
  mutate(year   = as.integer(year),
         period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre", "Post")))


es_pair <- function(df, o1, o2) {
  d <- df |>
    filter(outlet %in% c(o1, o2)) |>
    mutate(outlet = relevel(droplevels(factor(outlet)), ref = o1),
           year_f = droplevels(year_f))
  glm(mean_pos ~ year_f * outlet, data = d,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), weights = n_sent)
}

pairs_list <- list(
  FT_vs_WSJ       = c("FT", "WSJ"),
  Guardian_vs_NYT = c("Guardian", "NYTimes"),
  WSJ_vs_NYT      = c("WSJ", "NYTimes"),
  FT_vs_Guardian  = c("FT", "Guardian")
)

get_es <- function(df, base) {
  d <- df |> mutate(year_f = relevel(factor(year), ref = base))
  imap_dfr(pairs_list, \(o, nm) {
    m <- es_pair(d, o[1], o[2])
    tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(str_detect(term, "^year_f.*:outlet")) |>
      mutate(pair = nm,
             year = as.integer(str_extract(term, "\\d{4}")),
             base = base)
  }) |>
    bind_rows(tibble(pair = names(pairs_list), year = as.integer(base),
                     estimate = 0, conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0, base = base))
}


es_2022 <- get_es(art, "2022")

ggplot(es_2022, aes(year, estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.92, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(es_2022$year))) +
  labs(y = "DiD estimate (log-odds relative to 2022 baseline)", x = "Year",
       title = "Event study of Sentiment Gaps between Outlets by year") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```


## OPTIONAL WORD CLOUDS: To digger deeper into each topic, I had made word clouds for every outletxperiodxtopic pair



```{r}
library(quanteda)
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("quanteda.textplots")
library(quanteda.textplots)

data_filtered %>% filter(outlet != "Sun") |> filter(outlet != "NP") |> 
  group_by(outlet, period, Name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  pwalk(function(outlet, period, Name, data) {
    toks <- tokens(data$sentence, tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) |>  tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai")) 
    mat <- dfm(toks)
    
    filename <- paste0("wordcloud_", outlet, "_", period, "_T", Name, ".png")
    png(filename, width = 800, height = 600)
    textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 100)
    title(paste(outlet, "|", period, "|", "Topic", Name))
    dev.off()
    
    cat("✓", filename, "\n")
  })
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textplots)

data_filtered %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  pwalk(function(Name, data) {
    toks <- tokens(data$sentence, tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
      tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai"))
    mat <- dfm(toks)
    
    if (nfeat(mat) < 5) {
      cat("SKIP: T", topic, "- too sparse\n")
      return()
    }
    
    cat("\nTopic", topic, "\n")
    textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 100, min_count = 1)
  })
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(gridExtra)

for (per in c("pre", "post")) {
  outlets_list <- data_filtered %>% filter(period == per) |> filter(outlet != "Sun") |> filter(outlet != "NP") %>% pull(outlet) %>% unique()
  
  plots <- map(outlets_list, function(out) {
    toks <- data_filtered %>%
      filter(period == per, outlet == out) %>%
      pull(sentence) %>%
      tokens(tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
      tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai"))
    
    mat <- dfm(toks)
    
    if (nfeat(mat) < 5) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 100, min_count = 1) +
      ggtitle(out)
  })
  
  plots <- discard(plots, is.null)
  grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 2, top = per)
}
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textplots)

for (per in c("pre", "post")) {
  cat("\n========== PERIOD:", per, "==========\n")
  
  outlet_list <- c("WSJ", "FT", "NYTimes", "Guardian")
  topic_list <- unique(data_filtered$Name)
  
  for (out in outlet_list) {
    for (top in topic_list) {
      toks <- data_filtered %>%
        filter(period == per, outlet == out, topic == top) %>%
        pull(sentence) %>%
        tokens(tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
        tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai"))
      
      mat <- dfm(toks)
      
      if (nfeat(mat) < 3) {
        cat("SKIP:", out, "|", top, "- too sparse\n")
        next
      }
      
      cat("\n", out, "|", top, "\n")
      
      tryCatch({
        textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 50, min_count = 1)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("ERROR plotting:", out, "|", top, "\n")
      })
    }
  }
}
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(gridExtra)

for (per in c("pre", "post")) {
  plots <- data_filtered %>%
    filter(period == per) %>%
    group_by(outlet, period, Name) %>%
    nest() %>%
    pmap(function(outlet, period, Name, data) {
      toks <- tokens(data$sentence, tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
        tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai"))
      mat <- dfm(toks)
      
      if (nfeat(mat) < 5) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      p <- recordPlot()
      textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 100, min_count = 1)
      p <- recordPlot()
      
      return(p)
    }) %>%
    discard(is.null)
  
  if (length(plots) > 0) {
    grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 5, top = paste("Period:", per))
  }
}
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textplots)

for (per in c("pre", "post")) {
  dir.create(paste0("wordclouds_", per), showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  data_filtered %>%
    filter(period == per) %>%
    group_by(outlet, period, Name) %>%
    nest() %>%
    pwalk(function(outlet, period, Name, data) {
      toks <- tokens(data$sentence, tolower = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE) %>%
        tokens_remove(c(stopwords("english"), "ai"))
      mat <- dfm(toks)
      
      if (nfeat(mat) < 5) {
        return()
      }
      
      filename <- paste0("wordclouds_", per, "/", outlet, "_", Name, ".png")
      png(filename, width = 600, height = 500)
      textplot_wordcloud(mat, max_words = 100, min_count = 1)
      title(paste(outlet, "|", Name))
      dev.off()
      
      cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
    })
}
```
